title: Length under iterated second-component decoding
statement: Let $w$ be any finite bit string, and let $i$ be a natural number. Repeatedly take the second component returned by the aligned pair parser, using the empty word whenever parsing fails. After $i$ such operations, the resulting bit string has length at most $|w|$.
